definition: excessive grief.
example_en: She fell into excessive grief at her son's death.

definition: the quality of being illuminative or tending to illuminate.
example: ಆ ದೀಪದ ಪ್ರದೀಪಕತೆ ಇಡೀ ಬೀದಿಗೆ ಬೆಳಕು ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The illuminative quality of that lamp gave light to the whole street.

definition: the act or practice of accepting bribes.
example_en: The officials' practice of taking bribes is troubling the people.

definition: either of the two fleshy, rounded parts at the back of the hips; either half of the rump; the buttock.
example_en: He got hurt on the buttock when he fell.

definition: intense anger; wild rage; fierceness.
example_en: Wild rage appeared in his eyes.

definition: a being who has lost the goodhood; a former deity.
example: ಆ ಪೂರ್ವದೇವ ಶಾಪದಿಂದ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That former deity had lost its status due to a curse.

definition: causing hostility, discomfort or sickness; unpleasant.
example_en: The unpleasant effect of that medicine became apparent.

definition: stubborn refusal to submit or yield oneself to; contumacy; stubbornness.
example: ಅವಳ ಚದಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಬುದ್ಧಿ ಹೇಳಿದರೂ ಬಿಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: No amount of advice made her give up her stubbornness.

definition: bodily confort or pleasure.
example_en: He had bodily comfort from the soft bed.

definition: moulded jaggery (as dif. from shapeless or lump jaggery);
example_en: Moulded jaggery is made by pouring it into a mould.

definition: the burden caused by a worry or worries.
example: ಮಗನ ಆರೋಗ್ಯದ ಚಿಂತಾಭರ ಅವಳ ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಕುಗ್ಗಿಸಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The burden of worry about her son's health had weighed down her mind.

definition: a man who has invested capital in a business enterprise; an investor; a capitalist.
example_en: The capitalist took a large loan from the bank.

definition: a small marble-shaped sweet meat, made of rice-flour, fried in ghee.
example_en: Grandmother prepared the marble-shaped sweetmeat for the festival.

definition: in a small degree; to a slight extent; only slightly; not much; little.
example_en: He came in a little while.

definition: of small stature; undersized; stunted; dwarfish.
example_en: That tree remained stunted in its growth.

definition: to be in association with; to deal with; to have a company of.
example_en: It is good to associate with good people.

definition: a cart pushed by hand (esp. one used by street vendors).
example_en: He was filling the hand-pushed cart with fruits and selling them.

definition: a special race for runners in which they must leap over a series of frame-like barriers; a hurdle-race.
example: ಅವನು ತಡೆಯೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಅಡೆತಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ದಾಟಿ ಗೆದ್ದನು.
example_en: He crossed all the hurdles and won the hurdle-race.

definition: one whose work is examining records, people, etc. or conducting examinations in a school or schools; an examiner.
example: ಆ ಮೋಹತಮೀಮ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಉತ್ತರ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That examiner checked all the answer papers.

definition: a case for holding or carrying arrows; a quiver.
example_en: The hunter set out with a quiver tied to his back.

definition: (hist.) a person appointed by a king, president of a nation as the head of a division, district; a governor.
example_en: That district was being ruled by a governor.

definition: any small finchlike bird of the family Ploceidae, with brown and grey plumage Passer domesticus; a house sparrow.
example_en: The house sparrow built a nest on the roof of the house.

definition: a man, who leads an unrestrained, sexually immoral life; a rake; a libertine.
example_en: That libertine was corrupting the women of the village.

definition: a bitter curse.
example_en: The old woman gave him a bitter curse.

definition: a draft of a law proposed to a lawmaking body, as a legislative assembly, parliament, etc.
example_en: The government introduced a new bill in the assembly.

definition: to have a desire for.
example_en: She had a desire to buy a new saree.

definition: existence - a) the state or fact of existing; being; b) continuance in being.
example_en: The existence of this world is not eternal.

definition: one's personal or household work.
example_en: He finished his personal/household work quickly.

definition: cleverness; deftness; dexterity; ingenuity.
example: ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಸಲು ಅವನ ಚತುರವೃತ್ತಿ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: His dexterity helped in solving the problem.

definition: to spring, jump up.
example_en: The bird sprang up from the tree into the sky.

definition: a Dravidian language akin to Kuī spoken in some parts of Orissa in eastern India.
example: ಒಡಿಶಾದ ಕೆಲವು ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟುಗಳವರು ಕೊಂಡ ಭಾಷೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Some tribal people of Orissa speak the Konda language.

definition: the act of holding, grasping.
example_en: His grasp was very strong.

definition: the quality of being shrewd, quick, brisk; acumen; smartness.
example: ಅವನ ಚಾಲೋಕು ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನೂ ಬೇಗ ಬಗೆಹರಿಸಿತು.
example_en: His shrewdness quickly resolved all the problems.

definition: the plant Securinega leucopyrus ( = Flueggea leucopyrus) of Euphorbiaceae family.
example_en: A hūli plant had grown near the fence.

definition: a kind of bread in small, soft cakes, raised with baking powder or soda or sometimes with yeast; a biscuit.
example_en: They gave the child biscuits along with tea.

definition: to draw (someone or something) towards oneself.
example_en: His words drew the people toward him.

definition: to have (a thing in one's possession); to possess or contain as a part, characteristic, attribute, etc.
example_en: That book contains a great deal of knowledge.

definition: a critical examination, observation or evaluation; a test.
example_en: The committee conducted an evaluation of the project.

definition: to talk quietly or furtively, as in telling a secret; to whisper.
example_en: The two friends were whispering secretly.

definition: a kind of tall, slender reed.
example_en: The tall slender reed had grown high near the pond.

definition: a frontal worn on the forehead; a frontlet.
example_en: The bride wore a beautiful frontlet on her forehead.

definition: a crisp dish made by stuffing with sweet powder or mixture, fried in oil or ghee.
example_en: Children like puri-gadubu very much.

definition: a diplomatic representative appointed by one country or government to represent it in another; a diplomat.
example_en: That diplomat was the negotiator of the peace treaty.

definition: a man who has committed a crime; a criminal.
example_en: The police arrested that criminal.

definition: a high speed.
example_en: The hawk swooped upon its prey with a high speed.

definition: a kind of bord plant.
example_en: The sandalwood plant spreads fragrance in the forest.

definition: to gain or regain life or consciousness.
example: ಮೂರ್ಛೆ ಹೋದವನು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸಮಯದ ನಂತರ ಚೈತನ್ಯಂಬಡೆದನು.
example_en: The man who had fainted regained consciousness after a short while.

definition: the flesh of any animal as food; meat.
example_en: The butcher sells meat in the shop.

definition: the sky.
example_en: Stars were twinkling in the sky.

definition: the long, thick crest of something; a thick ridge.
example_en: The thick ridge of the hill was visible even from a distance.

definition: now; at this point of time.
example_en: Now I am at home itself.

definition: a kind of reptile of Squamata order, with a long slender body and tail, scaly skin, four legs, lives on small insects in hot region; a house lizard.
example: ಗವುಳಿ ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಸಣ್ಣ ಕೀಟಗಳನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The house lizard sits on the wall and catches small insects.

definition: to fasten or attach (a thing) so that it is supported only from above or at a point near its own top; to suspend.
example_en: He suspended the cloth from the wall.

definition: to refuse to take, accept, agree to; to reject.
example_en: The officer rejected that application.

definition: to become expansive.
example_en: When the rain came, the plant's leaves became expansive.

definition: a kind of disease in which the body bends backward and becomes stiffened.
example: ಆ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಹಿಂಬೆಱಗು ಎಂಬ ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಕಾಯಿಲೆ ಬಂದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That child suffered from the strange disease that bends the body backward and stiffens it.

definition: increasing; developing; growing.
example: ಈ ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಸಸಿಗಳಿಗೆ ವರ್ಧಕವಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This fertilizer acts as a growth-promoter for the saplings.

definition: anything one has to do or that which is done; a task; a work; a job.
example_en: This task must be finished by tomorrow.

definition: to cause to kill, murder.
example_en: The king had the traitor killed by his soldiers.

definition: the dried, ripe fruit (as coconut).
example_en: They broke the dried ripe coconut and offered it for worship.

definition: an attesting of a fact, statement, etc. of a person who saw (the incidence being examined); witness; evidence; testimony.
example_en: His testimony was accepted in the court.

definition: a small hand-held firearm; a pistol.
example_en: There was a pistol at the policeman's waist.

definition: to fall across; to lay oneself across.
example_en: A tree fell across the road and caused an obstruction to traffic.

definition: a pulling or being pulled back and forth or up and down repeatedly.
example_en: The children were scared seeing the boat's back-and-forth pulling.

definition: the act of committing treachery against the gods.
example: ಆ ರಾಕ್ಷಸ ಅನಿಮಿಷದ್ರೋಹ ಎಸಗಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಗುರಿಯಾದ.
example_en: That demon committed treachery against the gods and was punished.

definition: a stroke; a blow.
example_en: The blow of his hand struck the chest.

definition: a more than sufficient quantity or number; abundance.
example_en: After the rain, there was an abundance of grain.

definition: a disorder of the muscles of the eyes, as cross-eye, in which both eyes cannot be focused on the same point at the same time; strabismus.
example_en: The girl with strabismus looked at herself in the mirror.

definition: (wonder) to befall.
example_en: Wonder befell her when she saw that sight.

definition: (pl.) all the people.
example_en: All the people joined together and celebrated the festival.

definition: the diameter of the earth.
example_en: The geographers calculated the diameter of the earth.

definition: the act of killing oneself intentionally; suicide.
example_en: The nation's protection became possible through the soldiers' self-sacrifice.

definition: at that time; at that point of time.
example_en: At that time, a famine had struck the village.

definition: a member of a Zoroastrian religious sect in India descended from a group of Persian refugees who fled from the Muslim persecutions of the 7th and 8th centuries; a Parsee.
example: ಆ ನಗರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅರಿಮಣ ಸಮುದಾಯದವರು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Parsees mostly live in that city.

definition: the fact of being spread over a wide area.
example: ಬಳ್ಳಿಯ ಹಬ್ಬು ಇಡೀ ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The spreading of the creeper was across the whole wall.

definition: a kind of sweet meat.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ದಿನ ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಬಾಬರ ಎಂಬ ಸಿಹಿ ತಯಾರಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: On the festival day, grandmother made the sweet called babara.

definition: the cardinal number thirteen; 13.
example: ಈ ತಿಂಗಳ ತೇರಸ ದಿನ ಶುಭಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಯೋಗ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The thirteenth day of this month is auspicious for a good deed.

definition: the act of inquiring; an investigation or examination.
example_en: The police conducted an investigation into the incident.

definition: the shell of any of mollusk Cypraea moneta; a cowrie.
example_en: In the past, cowrie shells were used in place of money.

definition: higher education in a high school, college or university.
example_en: He received higher education abroad.

definition: a giving birth to a child.
example_en: After giving birth, the mother picked up the baby.

definition: something given as a gift, esp. to a temple, revered person, etc.
example_en: The devotees gave an offering to the temple.

definition: in this manner, way, type, fashion etc.
example_en: The teacher appreciated the letter written in this manner.

definition: that which is or has become, unproductive (as a cow).
example_en: That cow has now become unproductive.

definition: a decorative cloths tied to the top of portion of a pendal, a throne, etc.
example: ಮದುವೆಯ ಚಪ್ಪರದ ಮೇಲ್ಗಟ್ಟುಗೆ ಬಣ್ಣದ ಬಟ್ಟೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಿದರು.
example_en: They tied colourful cloths to the decorative top-hanging of the wedding pandal.

definition: a bag, container etc. for packing a commodity.
example_en: He filled the grain into a sack.

definition: (gen.) a blossom of a plant; a flower.
example_en: She offered a flower to the god.

definition: a man engaged in, tend to engage in, fighting.
example_en: People gathered and pacified that habitual fighter.

definition: not fixed or planted firmly; not secure; unsteady.
example_en: This table stands unsteadily.

definition: to put or pass through a sieve; to sift; to sieve.
example: ಅವಳು ಬೆಲ್ಲದ ಪುಡಿಯನ್ನು ಜಲ್ಲಿಸಿ ಕಸ ತೆಗೆದಳು.
example_en: She sifted the jaggery powder and removed the dirt.

definition: a pile, mound of rubbish things.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಹಿಂದೆ ಹಳೆಯ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಕೊಂಪೆ ಬಿದ್ದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A pile of old rubbish lay behind the house.

definition: an upward slope as of ground; acclivity.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ತೆಣೆಯನ್ನು ಹತ್ತಲು ನಮಗೆ ಬಹಳ ಸಮಯ ಹಿಡಿಯಿತು.
example_en: It took us a long time to climb the upward slope of the hill.

definition: a battle; a combat; a fight.
example_en: The soldiers' battle continued at the border.

definition: to rub, knead, etc. a part of the body, usu. with the hands, to stimulate circulation and make muscles or joints supple, relieve tension, etc.; to massage.
example_en: His guilt was established from this evidence.

definition: chronology - a) the science of measuring time in fixed periods and of dating events and epochs and arranging them in the order of occurrence; b) the arrangement of events, dates, etc. in the order of occurrence.
example: ಆ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ಕಾಲಗಣನಶಾಸ್ತ್ರವನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That student studied chronology in depth.

definition: an inflammed swelling of a lymph node, esp. in the armpit or groin; a bubo.
example_en: A bubo appeared in his armpit and caused him pain.

definition: condition, quality, fact or instance of being responsible; obligation, accountability, etc. responsibility.
example_en: The responsibility of the family is on him.

definition: the habitual act of making merry, taking much pleasure, engaging in gratifying oneself.
example_en: The rich man's habit of merry-making was very costly.

definition: a bashful, timid person; a person lacking boldness and confidence.
example_en: The timid person said nothing in the meeting.

definition: a kind of percussion instrument.
example_en: The artist played the percussion instrument rhythmically.

definition: Śiva, the consort of Pārvati.
example_en: Devotees worship Shiva, the consort of Parvati, at Kailasa.

definition: the act or work of boring holes in diamonds, pearls.
example_en: The goldsmith bored holes in the pearls.

definition: absence or want of natural strength or essence; strengthlessness.
example_en: Due to the long illness, his body became strengthless.

definition: an institution for receiving, lending, exchanging, and safeguarding money; a bank.
example_en: He took a loan from the bank.

definition: not clean; dirty; unclean; filthy; foul.
example_en: That water was unclean and not fit for drinking.

definition: a greater amount, quantity or degree; more.
example_en: There has been a greater amount of harvest this time.

definition: a woman who administers an anaesthetic or is skilled in producing anaesthesia; an anaesthesiologist; an anaesthetist.
example: ಆಕೆ ಅನುಭವಿ ಅಱಿವಳಿಕೆತಜ್ಞೆಯಾಗಿ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: She works at the hospital as an experienced anaesthetist.

definition: to catch fire; to start burning and emit light.
example_en: The dry leaves caught fire and started burning.

definition: disturbed sleep; a waking up before having one's full sleep.
example_en: The noise at night gave him disturbed sleep.

definition: the act of applying light touches or strokes to (a person or part of a person's body) so as to excite the nerves and usu. produce laughter and spasmodic movement; tickle; a tickling.
example_en: When the child was tickled, it laughed loudly.

definition: to sustain the burden of; to take on; to bear.
example_en: He bore the responsibility of the family.

definition: to be affected by fungus that attacks wood when exposed to damp and lose strength; to be mildewed.
example_en: The wooden pillar has mildewed because of the rain.

definition: to strongly crave for; to desire.
example_en: The child is craving to eat something sweet.

definition: free from defect or damage; in good condition; repaired.
example: ಗಡಿಯಾರ ಈಗ ದುರುಸ್ತುವಾಗಿ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದೆ.
example_en: The clock is now repaired and working properly.

definition: a string of gold or silver for wearing round the neck; a necklace.
example_en: Her necklace was made of gold.

definition: a forest; jungle; woods.
example_en: The children gathered fruits in the forest.

definition: to come together in large number; to form a crowd.
example_en: People had formed a large crowd at the fair.

definition: little in size; not large or big.
example: ಈ ಚೀಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಿಱಿದು ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಉಳಿದಿದೆ.
example_en: Only a little rice remains in this bag.

definition: to break or crush by violence; to smash.
example_en: In anger, he smashed the pot to pieces.

definition: sorrowfulness; loss of courage or hope; dejection; despondency.
example_en: The defeat caused dejection in him.

definition: the act of stabbing, piercing, prodding or poking.
example: ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಶತ್ರುವಿನ ತಿವಿತ ಅವನ ಎದೆಗೆ ತಾಗಿತು.
example_en: In the battle the enemy's stabbing struck his chest.

definition: the side wall on the thoracic and abdominal segments of an arthropod; pleuron.
example_en: The scorpion's pleuron was clearly visible under the microscope.

definition: a stout thing.
example_en: That rock was a stout mass.

definition: a state of mental distress; trouble; agony.
example_en: They were weary from the trouble of the journey.

definition: one who is infected with such a disease which is transmitted to another by physical contact.
example_en: The infected patient was kept in a separate room.

definition: the condition or quality of being dwarfish or having stunted growth; dwarfishness.
example: ಅವನ ಕುರ್ಗು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಎತ್ತರದ ಕೆಲಸಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡ್ಡಿಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: His dwarfishness stood in the way of his getting tall jobs.

definition: being at a higher level.
example: ಆ ಅಟ್ಟ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಿಂದ ಇಡೀ ಊರು ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The whole town can be seen from that higher region.

definition: a place affording protection, as from the elements or danger; a shelter.
example_en: The travelers rested at the shelter.

definition: to cause darkness; to make dark or darker; to darken.
example_en: The clouds darkened the sky.

definition: any organised procession, march or display, by a military or police force.
example_en: The police parade was held in the morning on the ground.

definition: the period of light between the sunrise and sunset.
example_en: During broad daylight, people were bustling in the market.

definition: the condition of being arranged or disposed in a neat, tidy manner or in a regular sequence; tidiness; orderliness.
example_en: The tidiness of her house amazed everyone.

definition: to light (a lamp, burner, etc.) to ignite.
example_en: He lit the stove and cooked food.

definition: clever; intelligent; skillful.
example_en: Although he is young, he is very clever.

definition: by chance; incidentally; perhaps.
example: ಮಸಲ ನಾವು ಆ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ತಲುಪಬಹುದು.
example_en: Perhaps we might reach there right on time.

definition: the profession of farmer; farming.
example_en: His father had taken up farming as his livelihood.

definition: a plantation on red-earth.
example: ಅವನ ಕೆಬ್ಬೆತೋಟ ಕೆಂಪು ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: His plantation on red earth has grown well.

definition: to come to the front.
example_en: The soldiers came to the front.

definition: to go; to move voluntarily one place to another.
example_en: He goes to work every morning.

definition: in all or several directions; without any direction.
example_en: The sparks of fire scattered in all directions.

definition: yoked pair of horses or oxen.
example: ಆ ರಥವನ್ನು ಎಳೆಯಲು ಆಯೋಗ ಎತ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಿದರು.
example_en: They yoked a pair of oxen to pull that chariot.

definition: to capture or apprehend; to arrest.
example_en: The police arrested the thief.

definition: an instance of cheating that is unearthed.
example_en: That fraudulent deal came to light as an exposed cheating.

definition: a small flat ornament worn as a frontlet at the partition of hair in combing.
example_en: She wore a small flat ornament at the parting of her hair while combing.

definition: to divide, break or make separate, esp. by cutting; to sever.
example: ಅವನು ಹಗ್ಗವನ್ನು ಕಂಡಿಸಿ ಎರಡು ತುಂಡು ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He severed the rope and made it into two pieces.

definition: a measure of grain (equal to twenty koḷagas ?).
example_en: They measured out one kodi of paddy and gave it.

definition: a sword fight.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರು ವೀರರ ನಡುವೆ ಭೀಕರ ಶಸ್ತ್ರಯುದ್ಧ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A fierce sword fight took place between the two warriors.

definition: (strands of fibre) to be intertwisted.
example_en: The strands of fibre became strongly intertwisted.

definition: a printed document with blank spaces to be filled in; a form.
example_en: He carefully filled in the application form.

definition: any of various large, ferocious cats, including the jaguar and snow leopard having a tawny coat spotted with black; a leopard.
example_en: The leopard hunted the deer in the forest.

definition: incessantly; uninterruptedly; continually; eternally.
example_en: He kept working incessantly.

definition: to move or go ahead on one's way.
example_en: The travellers moved ahead on their way early in the morning.

definition: to swing from side to side or back to forth.
example_en: The baby was swinging back and forth in the cradle and laughing.

definition: not perishable; that will not die or decay; imperishable; indestructible; immortal.
example_en: They believe that the soul is imperishable.

definition: a resentfully envious man.
example: ಹುರುಡಿಗನಾದ ಅವನು ಇತರರ ಏಳಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಮರುಗಿದನು.
example_en: Being a resentfully envious man, he grieved at the sight of others' prosperity.

definition: th act or process of painting, colouring.
example_en: That painter's colouring was very beautiful.

definition: a man of good disposition or character; a virtuous man.
example_en: In the village, he was respected as a man of good character.

definition: to become round, circular.
example_en: The cooked dough became round as it cooled.

definition: the grass Saccharum spontaneum of Poaceae family the reed of which is used for making thatches; thatch grass.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಗುಡಿಸಲಿಗೆ ನಾೞಲ್ ಹುಲ್ಲಿನ ಚಾವಣಿ ಹಾಕಿದರು.
example_en: They roofed the village hut with thatch grass.

definition: any theological doctrine.
example: ಆ ಗ್ರಂಥವು ಒಂದು ಹೊಸ ದೇವತಾಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತವನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That book explains a new theological doctrine.

definition: the plant Basella rubra of Basellaceae family; Indian spinach.
example: ಹಿತ್ತಲಿನ ಬೇಲಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಾವುಬಚ್ಚಲು ಬಳ್ಳಿ ಹಬ್ಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The Indian spinach vine had spread over the backyard fence.

definition: a ring of light that seems to encircle the sun, moon, etc.
example_en: A ring of light appeared around the moon in the sky.

definition: to render a person utterly helpless; to deprive a person of all means.
example: ಆ ಕಳ್ಳರು ಅವನನ್ನು ಸೂರೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಮುಟ್ಟುಗಿಡಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Those thieves robbed him and rendered him utterly helpless.

definition: the state of being liberated (from the arbitrary control of another); liberation.
example_en: He practiced spiritual discipline for the liberation of the soul.

definition: to stand erect.
example_en: The soldier stood erect with discipline.

definition: to go to the final point or end.
example_en: The journey reached its final end today.

definition: a consonant in its original form (viz. not compounded with any vowel).
example_en: This letter is written in its original consonant form.

definition: one of the classes of microcosmic unicellular algae with flinty shells in two halves, fitting like box and lid; diatom.
example_en: Diatoms grow in the pond water.

definition: a most important question.
example_en: He raised a most important question in the meeting.

definition: well-being, happiness; health and prosperity (of a person or community etc.); welfare.
example: ಈ ಔಷಧಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಪದಿಲವನ್ನು ಕಾಪಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This medicine preserves health and well-being.

definition: an ornamental tuft of threads; a tassel.
example: ಅವಳ ಸೀರೆಯ ಅಂಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದಾರಗೊಂಡೆ ಜೋತು ಬಿದ್ದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A tassel was hanging from the edge of her saree.

definition: to collect, gather or amass.
example_en: He gathered and kept the money.

definition: a narrow opening through which bullets are shot from within.
example_en: There was a narrow opening for shooting bullets in the fort wall.

definition: a kind of spicy food made of rice and cucumber.
example_en: They made the spicy rice-and-cucumber dish at home for the festival.

definition: to cause to plough (a piece of land).
example_en: The farmer had that field ploughed.

definition: an article in a news paper by the editor giving her or his considered opinion on an issue of current importance; an editorial; a leader.
example_en: The editor wrote the editorial.

definition: a ditch, a moat.
example_en: There was a deep moat around the fort.

definition: a variety of sugarcane.
example_en: The hullugabbu variety of sugarcane grows well in open areas.

definition: the falling of value.
example_en: The fall in the value of the rupee caused worry in the market.

definition: storm accompanied by rain.
example_en: A storm with rain arose on the coast and disrupted daily life.

definition: to utter a loud, deep, rumbling sound; to roar.
example_en: The tiger roared at night.

definition: (masc.) a person guarding the entrance of a building; a doorkeeper.
example: ಕಂಬಿಗ ಬಾಗಿಲ ಬಳಿ ನಿಂತು ಯಾರನ್ನೂ ಒಳಗೆ ಬಿಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The doorkeeper stood by the door and let no one in.

definition: a man or boy whose job is tend, feed, and curry horses; a groom.
example_en: The palace groom got the horses bathed.
